source0_callback.interpretation: The retail source-0 callback reached the guest deferred-callback handler in this run. The callback's MMIO source gate was therefore open on these entries.

deferred_queue_samples.interpretation: The four logged source-0 handler entries found no queued deferred record at the sampled read/write indices.

supported: Source-0 delivery and entry into the original deferred-callback handler are observed in this exact Linux guest run.
The sampled deferred callback queue was empty (read index 0, write index 0, first record zero).
The predicate values sampled at software-queue helper entry did not contain the 0x02 completion mask tested by 0x823A0310.
not_proven: This does not identify why the deferred callback queue is empty or identify the host-side producer for the software-queue completion bit.
The probe does not establish the guest program counter after the callback, main-menu progress, visible output, or offline-race progress.
The run did not capture a raw Vulkan readback. Related diagnostic runs with the same renderer-plugin hash are recorded separately in xbox360_linux_diagnostic_surfaces_20261024.json.
